meta.name: skill-creator
meta.description: Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, edit, or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, or optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建、修改和优化技能，并评估其表现
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要创建或改进自定义技能
copy.tagline_en: Create, modify, and optimize skills, and measure their performance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create or improve custom skills

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你从头创建新技能、修改或优化已有技能，还能运行测试来评估技能表现，并优化技能描述以提高触发准确性。
howto.when: 当你想创建新技能、编辑或优化已有技能、运行评估测试、对比技能性能，或优化技能描述以提高触发准确性时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个技能，把Markdown文件转换成PDF。
say.note: Claude 会引导你定义技能细节并生成草稿。

say.text: 优化这个技能的描述，让它更容易被触发。
say.note: Claude 会运行描述优化脚本来改进触发词。

say.text: 运行评估测试，看看这个技能表现如何。
say.note: Claude 会创建测试用例并执行对比测试。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you create new skills from scratch, modify or improve existing skills, run evaluations to test skill performance, and optimize skill descriptions for better triggering accuracy.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to create a new skill, edit or optimize an existing skill, run evaluation tests, benchmark skill performance, or optimize skill descriptions for better triggering.

say_en.text: Create a skill that converts Markdown files to PDF.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through defining details and drafting the skill.

say_en.text: Optimize this skill's description to make it trigger more easily.
say_en.note: Claude will run the description improver script.

say_en.text: Run evaluation tests to see how this skill performs.
say_en.note: Claude will create test cases and run comparative tests.
